method: Fresh context per run (phone viewport 390×844 @2x). CDP Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate throttles the renderer main thread only (Chromium thread_cpu_throttler.cc: 200 µs quanta, busy-wait). Probe starts 300 ms after load. Frame probe: the default work unit (12k particles integrated + 400 rects on a 128² 2D canvas) once per rAF for 2 s, no early exit, so any shorter probe is evaluated on prefixes of the same runs. cond=busy: twelve ~60 ms (at 1x) CPU tasks every 90 ms during the probe (a page still booting). Calibration: 5 separate runs at 1x quiet; bands at the geometric midpoints between the throttle levels (2.0× and 4.9× the calibrated 1x median).
